## Additional Resources


- **[Vectors | Chapter 1, Essence of linear algebra](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fNk_zzaMoSs&list=PLZHQObOWTQDPD3MizzM2xVFitgF8hE_ab&index=2), by [3Blue1Brown](https://www.youtube.com/@3blue1brown)** -- a YouTube video covering vector fundamentals
- **[Vector Calculus: Understanding the Dot Product](https://betterexplained.com/articles/vector-calculus-understanding-the-dot-product/)** by [Kallid Azad from Better Explained](https://betterexplained.com/about/) explains the intuition behind the dot product. There's a fun Mario Kart analogy.
